  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'first_open' THEN user_pseudo_id END) as first_open_users,

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'app_exception' THEN user_pseudo_id END) as crash_users
FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
WHERE event_name IN ('first_open', 'app_remove', 'app_exception')
